description: An oil-painted scene in a dim studio. A man with glasses, rolled shirt sleeves and a dark waistcoat leans over a wooden desk and writes with a pen on paper covered in large block capitals (ABCDEF, GHIJK, and a partial row). Beside him stands a sign-board with a red-brown roundel and a black panel reading UNDERGROUND, with a second line below that reads UNDERGROUN. Ink pots, brushes, rolled papers and books sit around the room, with a window light on the left.
reason: Letters are painted into the picture: the alphabet sheets on the desk show readable capitals, and the sign reads UNDERGROUND with a garbled second line UNDERGROUN. The card needs an image without legible lettering, or with lettering that is not readable.
